PDF download assets (loaded only when requested)
jsPDF 4.2.1 - https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF - MIT
jsPDF-AutoTable 5.0.9 - https://github.com/simonbengtsson/jsPDF-AutoTable - MIT
Noto Sans JP - https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosansjp - SIL OFL 1.1
The regular font is a static weight-400 instance of NotoSansJP[wght].ttf,
created with fontTools 4.62.1. All glyphs are retained; the downloaded PDF
embeds only the glyphs used in that report. See adjacent license files.
No report or registration data is transmitted to a PDF generation service.

Noto Sans JP Bold is a static weight-700 instance, under the same SIL OFL license.
